trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; multiple deep, irregular notches and peaks distributed along the entire length of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep; trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curvature terminating in sharp distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan pigmentation area covering a significant portion of the lower-central and left-medial fluke surface.
